sourceDirection: User-restored original detailed Lynx artwork. Geometric proxies are rejected and excluded.

assets.method: Built-in ImageGen background extraction supplied alpha only. Generated RGB discarded; original RGB retained byte-for-byte through deterministic channel assembly.
assets.limit: Portrait alpha visually checked on light/dark backgrounds; fine edges remain a prototype and need artist cleanup before final release. Not a layered wardrobe asset.

assets.method: Byte-identical copy of original RGBA. No failed extraction output is used.
assets.limit: Original soft glow remains. Not a layered wardrobe asset.

bundling: Static local URLs. Full-resolution PNGs are separate emitted files, not inline base64. Combined uncompressed source payload is approximately 3.64 MB; release owner must assess loading budget. No runtime remote asset fetch or URL supplied by saved settings.
